name: C076 Chúa Tể Chuyển Nguyền (Quyền Trượng Hấp Nguyền Chuyển Họa)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of an Epic dark-fantasy Curse-Lord's hex-transference scepter staff (Quyền Trượng Hấp Nguyền Chuyển Họa - C076 Chúa Tể Chuyển Nguyền) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete occult hex-staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (dark bronze and bone-spiked shaft) to top-right (a twin-serpent Ouroboros cage holding a split yin-yang crystal orb: half toxic dark-violet curse energy and half luminous emerald-gold healing light).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom spike to top Ouroboros orb crest with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use blackened bronze, weathered bone, deep indigo-violet, and bright emerald-gold).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Curse-Transference Ouroboros Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal Ouroboros staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame curse-reflection vortex: dark-indigo hex chains being sucked into the orb and transmuted into swirling emerald-gold vitality runes.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Curse-Transference Ouroboros Staff (Quyền Trượng Hấp Nguyền Chuyển Họa - C076 Chúa Tể Chuyển Nguyền) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the Ouroboros twin-serpent staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a cursed gothic ritual sanctum where dark violet hex-chains are absorbed into the staff and hurled outward while warm emerald-gold healing light radiates behind it.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
